search.snippet: The anti-dragon shield is an item obtained from Duke Horacio in Lumbridge Castle during the Dragon Slayer quest. After the quest, the shield can be purchased from Oziach. It can also be obtained from other players regardless of their progress in the quest, but a player must have at least started Dragon Slayer in order to equip the shield. The anti-dragon shield mitigates the effects of dragonfire, reducing the maximum hit of most dragon-breath attacks by >80%. It also prevents Elvarg from severely draining the player's combat stats. The effects of antifire potion stack with the anti-dragon shield; using both provides full protection from standard dragonfire attacks. See full list on oldschoolrunescape.fandom.com Using a hammer and anvil, players with 90 Smithing (can be boosted) can attach a draconic visage to an anti-dragon shield to create a dragonfire shield. Doing so grants 2,000 Smithing experience. Players without the required level can bring the components to Oziach, who will assist in creating the shield for a payment of 1,250,000 coins. After Dragon Slayer II is complete, a Skeletal visage can be fused with the anti-dragon shield in a similar fashion, creating a Dragonfire ward. See full list on oldschoolrunescape.fandom.com •Originally, multiple shields could only be sourced from Duke Horacio by use of the drop trick. See full list on oldschoolrunescape.fandom.com Item is now created at the Blacksmith's Bench, as the Smithing Anvil has been removed from the game. The item's weight was changed from 7.0 kg to 10.0 kg. The item's journal entry was grammatically changed. Before an update you could plant Mithril seeds and then you couldn't put traps down. This was done to stop player harassment, but was also widely used to fuck with bots now you can place traps over flowers. The dragonfire shield is an upgraded Anti-dragon shield, and widely considered one of the best shields in the game, after the Elysian spirit shield and Dinh's bulwark. Anti-dragon shields have been changed to hybrid class. Decreased price from 80 to 20. Added to game. The anti-dragon shield appears on the friends chat tab in the game lobby.
